efficio_component_type.description: Identifies this shape as a text component.

efficio_text_format.description: How the generated text content should be structured.

ai.purpose: Selects the structural format of generated text.

enum_descriptions.plain: A single run of plain text.

efficio_sizing_mode.description: Whether text sizing limits are inferred automatically or set manually.

efficio_max_chars.description: Maximum total characters. MVP default is 30; auto sizing will later calculate this value.

ai.purpose: Hard limit on the total number of characters the generated text may use.

efficio_max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines. MVP default is 30; auto sizing will later calculate this value.

ai.purpose: Hard limit on the number of lines the generated text may use.

efficio_max_chars_per_line.description: Maximum characters per line. MVP default is 30; auto sizing will later calculate this value.

ai.purpose: Hard limit on the number of characters in any single line of the generated text.

example.efficio_prompt_instruction: Generate a concise executive slide title.
